regions.today: Cloudy this evening with further patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle, and light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: A mostly cloudy night with patchy rain and drizzle clearing early on. The rest of the night will be mostly dry with a few mist and fog patches developing. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees with mostly light westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will be mostly dry and after a cloudy start, some sunny spells will develop in the afternoon. Cloud will increase again in the evening and rain will gradually spread from the northwest around nightfall. A warm and humid day, with highest temperatures of 20 to 23 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate, high in sunshine on Monday and Tuesday
